calculation.description: Fade each instrument's lagged five-day return, scaled by its own trailing 20-day return volatility; cross-sectional median demeaned. Signal is evaluated using prices available through the completed signal date and forward returns begin the next day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily gate passes. Pre-2024 IC/ICIR 0.040852/0.125807; 2024-2025 0.017666/0.055757; online 2026-07-16 onward 0.055877/0.200683. Longer-horizon decay is evident, so use as a short-horizon component and monitor drift.
